jobs.description: Job Summary Ready to turn innovative ideas into real-world fragrance solutions? Join us and help develop, scale up and commercialize cutting-edge fragrance delivery technologies that enhance everyday experiences around the world. IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients, and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. Harnessing the full emotional power of scent, driven by pioneering creativity, science, consumer expertise and a mindful approach to fragrance design. As an Associate Engineer within the Delivery Processing R&D organization, you will contribute to the development, pilot validation, scale-up and commercialization of innovative fragrance delivery technologies in Benicarló. This role will focus on process engineering activities, pilot plant execution, experimental trials, process data collection and enable technology transfer from laboratory to pilot and manufacturing scale. The position is intended for an early-career engineer with strong interest in chemical process development, unit operations, scale-up, manufacturing readiness and industrial problem solving. Where You'll Make a Difference Execute laboratory, pilot plant and manufacturing-support trials for Delivery Systems technologies, following approved protocols and safety requirements. Contribute to process scale-up activities from bench to pilot and production scale, including preparation, execution, sampling, data capture and post-trial analysis. Collect, organize and analyze process data, including process conditions, yield, quality indicators, material balances and critical observations. Prepare clear technical summaries, trial reports, batch records, operating procedures and supporting documentation for internal review. Assist with process troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement activities in collaboration with scientists, engineers and manufacturing teams. Contribute to technology transfer activities with internal manufacturing sites and external toll manufacturers, including preparation of documentation and on-site trial guidance when required. Contribute to process safety reviews, risk assessments, basic equipment evaluations and operational readiness activities. Partner with R&D, Operations, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Procurement and Commercial teams as needed to enable project execution. Maintain accurate experimental records and communicate results, issues and next steps in a timely and structured manner; this role may involve up to 10% travel to global capsule manufacturing sites, pilot facilities and external toll manufacturers to contribute to process development, scale-up, technology transfer, troubleshooting and commercialization of Delivery Systems technologies. What Makes You the Right Fit Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline, with a strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Typically 0–3 years of relevant industrial, manufacturing, pilot plant, internship, research or experimental experience, demonstrating execution excellence in delivering activities with quality, safety and discipline. Basic understanding of chemical process operations, unit operations, pilot-scale experimentation and data interpretation. Ability to work safely and effectively in laboratory, pilot plant and manufacturing environments, consistently applying strong safety awareness and operational discipline. About the Team

The Customer Experience team serves as a foundational operations pillar at DoorDash, dedicated to resolving friction within the last mile. We architect and oversee an expansive global network of support centers — spanning both teammate-assisted and AI-driven support — obsessing over the user journey to ensure every interaction is seamless and reliable. As the analytics team, our mission is to make every support interaction measurably better: we define what a great resolution looks like, quantify where we fall short, and turn that into a roadmap for product, operations, and AI/ML partners. We are looking for a Manager to lead and grow the analytics team behind our core support experience.

About the Role

As a Manager on the Customer Experience Analytics team, you'll set the analytical vision for how DoorDash measures and improves customer resolutions across our global network of support teammates and their interactions with our customers. You'll lead and grow a team of data scientists working at the intersection of customer experience quality and operational cost — uncovering opportunities to drive perfect interactions and informing improvements to teammate tooling that leverages AI-driven resolutions. You'll establish a clear measurement framework for resolution quality, own insights to drive strategy and roadmap, and align partners across CX, Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI/ML. This is a high-visibility leadership role: success means better outcomes for customers, a more effective support organization, and a team of data scientists who are growing in their craft.
